intention: First payoff. I can see the swallowtail at the far left of Gobbo, the pale diamond centred on the grey cloth. The jars did not both fill. The flag showed up before I knew whether he would wake.

Town discovery. Reopened in Grove. I selected Square and touched the cups. There is Suki at the left, much smaller than his paws. The paper opened pink between them and his fold floated when I touched the water. Still 5169. I want the sign painters at this table next.

Town discovery. Eighty-one reached the porch. The cushion now has a brown curled cat beside the Giant. The envelope changed to Walk the cat home: meet it on the right before the shower, then turn left for the last hood. Following it now.

Town discovery. The cat stayed on the cushion on my first walk. On the second I stayed inside the right lane through the balloon until Cat aboard appeared, then held left. Only 965 friends, one star, but the yellow awning has the curled cat underneath it at the fountain. I like this ending better than the two-star miss.

Town discovery. 1967 was a one-star Lantern River; keeping near the centre caught the third lily. At the pond a pink flower sits between gold and lilac. Switching to Sunny bank moved the leaf and the ducks to the right without costing a Petal. That closes a goal I set in the first thirteen minutes.

Town discovery. The loaf and little handled cup are now gold in the glass; the next pair is a bell and lantern for 12. I chose Keep this outing for the snow keeper before I went to look. I would stop here and come back specifically to guide the rear bearer into the last pool, rather than farm for three more colours.
